about: Held-out synthetic public requests, written on 18 October 2026 after the reader rules were frozen, and run once. Not real messages; Sinhala and Tamil need native-speaker review. Labels as in public_requests.json; need may list several acceptable answers.

cases.text: The power has been off in Dehiowita town since 6 pm, a pole is leaning on the house next door.
Seventy people are staying at the Agalawatta temple and the rice ran out this morning.
Our tube well is under sea water after the storm surge. 18 people have nothing safe to drink.
A boulder rolled onto the road at the 7th mile post, buses are turning back.
My neighbour's house is cracking and the wall fell in. They need somewhere to sleep, 4 people.
Pregnant woman in labour, the road is flooded and the ambulance cannot reach us.
An old man fell into the canal and is missing since an hour.
Mobile signal gone for two days, we cannot reach our families abroad.
අපේ ප්‍රදේශයේ විදුලිය නැහැ ඊයේ රෑ ඉඳන්, ට්‍රාන්ස්ෆෝමරය පිපිරුණා.
පාසලේ 55 දෙනෙක් ඉන්නවා, බොන්න වතුර නැහැ.
කන්දේ ඉරිතැලීම් වැඩි වෙනවා, ගෙවල් අතහැරලා යන්න බයයි. උදව් කරන්න.
மின்சாரம் இல்லாமல் மூன்று நாட்கள் ஆகிவிட்டன, மருத்துவமனை ஜெனரேட்டரில் இயங்குகிறது.
45 பேர் பள்ளிவாசலில் தங்கியுள்ளோம், உணவு தேவை.
வெள்ளத்தில் ஒரு குழந்தை காணவில்லை, உடனே உதவி செய்யுங்கள்.
Aiyo the road to Pallebage is fully blocked machan, mud everywhere, no way to go.
Sea water entered our homes in Ambalangoda, 25 people need food and drinking water.
Karainagar causeway is under water, the only road out is closed.
